about: Emode's own rack: the quick picks any mirror without a store rack offers under its QR code -- 4 rows (suits, tops, bottoms, shoes) of 3 men's and 3 women's pieces. Photos live in public/rack/<gender>/<key>.jpg; replace one by dropping a new file at the same path, or change the list and run scripts/seed-house-rack.mjs. 'describe' was only used to generate placeholder photos.
